LEGACY-as-scored.change: reference: the engine as it was judged (simulate, flat fee, floor, absolute R)

LEGACY-rescored.change: reference: LEGACY-as-scored's admitted trades, scored with §5

A2.change: 2.5R floor in the harness, cost known at entry

parameters.placebo_draw: without replacement; every candidate when fewer
parameters.placebo_slot: server-clock minute of the day of the event's ENTRY bar k+1
parameters.dense: R0's pinned dense start per series (edge_wyckoff counts); dense days by edge_wyckoff.dense_days from it; the detection window must lie on or after the start
parameters.cluster: ISO week of the signal bar (UTC)

costs.times: entry = the fill instant (next open / signal close); exit = the exit bar's open label, the engine's own exit_time convention

disclosures.descriptive_only: no gate, no BH family, nothing selected (§7.1)
disclosures.legacy_admission: LEGACY arms' signals are bt.simulate's admitted trades per (symbol, timeframe): the flat-fee floor AND its one-position-per-symbol rule, which reads earlier trades' exit times; `count` reports the floor alone
disclosures.w7_contain_no_target: fx_w7_contain keeps the engine's W7 rule 'no HTF record, no Phase-D trade'; the family-W time exit (§3.3) is not an engine rule
disclosures.shakeout_short: fx_w_shakeout=test applies to both sides (a lingering Upthrust is entered at its test)
disclosures.a7_neutral: A7 bars without an earlier same-hour reference get volume 1.0 (counted per series)
disclosures.engine_test_volume: the engine's Test still needs tick volume (W:594) and its Shakeouts reclaim within sob, so A1 covers only that subset (§7.2 Limitation)
disclosures.dense_from_r0: the dense table is R0's (family W's), never recomputed on the cut series; signals whose detection window reaches before the dense start are dropped (counted); the HTF series bt.scan reads for the W7 target / HTF gate are not cut at the dense start
disclosures.code_fingerprint: code_sha256 = edge_wyckoff.code_sha256() over edge_wyckoff.CODE, equal in all 13 arms and to R0's
